content:
julia_finance: Alert from processor: multiple chargebacks on acct ACCT-6621 flagged as 'unauthorized' totaling $45.62 across three txns (0x9a1, 0x9a2, 0x9a3). Case group GC-2026-MAR-22 created. Deadline to respond: 2026-05-02T23:59Z. Is this card-testing or friendly fraud?

payments-bot: Automated: Chargeback bundle opened (case=GC-2026-MAR-22) amount=$45.62. Evidence deadline 2026-05-02T23:59Z.

omar_fraud: Quick hit: pattern looks like card-testing -> three micro charges 0.99, 1.23, 42.40 spaced 12m apart from same IP 34.210.11.99 and same device fingerprint. No prior disputes on BIN. Recommend contesting with device fingerprint + IP + API key owner if internal.

rex_ops: I checked logs: all three requests used API key prefix ak_live_MPZ and app_id=market-forms-2. We have usage payloads and response hashes. Will pull minimal evidence (no full prompts) and IP geo.

julia_finance: If we contest, processor requires merchant statement + proof of cardholder acceptance (receipt emails). But for suspected testing, many issuers still favor cardholder. What's cost v. effort?

omar_fraud: Low value but high fraud signal. If partner/merchant can show receipt and screen for TY and accept terms, contest. Else it may be faster to refund and block key and issue partner notice.

rex_ops: Action: disable API key ak_live_MPZ (done) and rotate keys for market-forms-2. Opened incident ticket INC-2026-331.

julia_finance: I'll prepare a short evidence packet (txn logs, IP, receipt sends). If partner is third-party marketplace, include their onboarding doc. Otherwise we'll concede these to avoid processor fees.

payments-bot: Note: auto-reversal on unsubmitted evidence after deadline.

omar_fraud: I'll monitor issuer responses. If any issuer pushes for more, we'll escalate to legal.

julia_finance: Final: Evidence uploaded for two micro txns; we conceded the large $42.40 to expedite. Marking case closed pending issuer final decision.

rex_ops: Key rotation complete, partner notified to rotate their integration keys. :lock:
